kpis.name_en: Worldwide procedures growth (da Vinci and Ion)

periods.quote: Worldwide procedures (da Vinci and Ion combined) grew approximately 17% compared with the first quarter of 2025.
Worldwide procedures (da Vinci and Ion combined) grew approximately 18% compared with the fourth quarter of 2024.
Worldwide procedures (da Vinci and Ion combined) grew approximately 20% compared with the third quarter of 2024.

kpis.name_fr: Base installée de systèmes da Vinci
kpis.name_en: da Vinci surgical system installed base

periods.quote: The Company grew its da Vinci surgical system installed base to 11,395 systems as of March 31, 2026, an increase of 12% compared with 10,189 as of March 31, 2025.
The Company grew its da Vinci surgical system installed base to 11,106 systems as of December 31, 2025, an increase of 12% compared with 9,902 as of December 31, 2024.
The Company grew its da Vinci surgical system installed base to 10,763 systems as of September 30, 2025, an increase of 13% compared with 9,539 as of September 30, 2024.
The Company grew its da Vinci surgical system installed base to 10,488 systems as of June 30, 2025, an increase of 14% compared with 9,203 as of June 30, 2024.
The Company grew its Ion endoluminal system installed base to 1,041 systems as of March 31, 2026, an increase of 22% compared with 853 as of March 31, 2025.
The Company grew its Ion endoluminal system installed base to 995 systems as of December 31, 2025, an increase of 24% compared with 805 as of December 31, 2024.
The Company grew its Ion endoluminal system installed base to 954 systems as of September 30, 2025, an increase of 30% compared with 736 as of September 30, 2024.

kpis.name_fr: Systèmes da Vinci placés sur le trimestre

periods.quote: The Company placed 431 da Vinci surgical systems, compared with 367 in the first quarter of 2025.
The Company placed 532 da Vinci surgical systems, compared with 493 in the fourth quarter of 2024.
The Company placed 427 da Vinci surgical systems, compared with 379 in the third quarter of 2024.
The Company placed 395 da Vinci surgical systems, compared with 341 in the second quarter of 2024.

kpis.name_fr: Systèmes da Vinci 5 placés sur le trimestre

periods.quote: The first quarter 2026 da Vinci surgical system placements included 232 da Vinci 5 systems, compared with 147 in the first quarter of 2025.
The fourth quarter 2025 da Vinci surgical system placements included 303 da Vinci 5 systems, compared with 174 in the fourth quarter of 2024.
The third quarter 2025 da Vinci surgical system placements included 240 da Vinci 5 systems, compared with 110 in the third quarter of 2024.
The second quarter 2025 da Vinci surgical system placements included 180 da Vinci 5 systems, compared with 70 in the second quarter of 2024.
